Full job description

Responsibilities:

· Assists the Accounting Manager in the day-to-day financial transactions.

· Supports in tax compliance function, ensuring submission of BIR reports on time as well as payment and remittances.

· Helps in checking billings, invoices, debit/credit memos, payment vouchers,

and settlements, Crew’s final pay, leave pay, bonuses and cash remittances, crews’ payroll and bank LOIs, Principal billings and monitoring of billings.

· Ensure prompt preparation of statutory financial and management reports.

· Reviews, analysis and presentation of financial reports in an accurate and timely manner.

· Clearly facilitates and communicates monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

· Aids in preparation of the annual corporate budget, in coordination with relevant division and department.

· Ensure prompt tracking of expenses against budget and implementation of corrective measures.

· Reviews monthly bank reconciliation of all bank accounts.

· Ensure proper management of financial resources; Regularly reviews Cash flow analysis and ensures proper placement of funds to achieve maximum limit subject to the approval of the Accounting Manager and Finance Director.

· Coordinates with the external auditors to ensure a smooth and efficient audit and informs/updates management of the Audit findings and corrective measures that should be taken.

· Monitors the general ledger accounting for compliance with the accepted other industry’s best practices, and Company guidelines.

Benefits:

  • Company Christmas gift
  • Health insurance
  • Promotion to permanent employee

Education:

  • Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

  • progressive accounting: 7 years (Required)

License/Certification:

  • Certified Public Accountant license (Required)

Work Location: In person

items.title: General Staff Accountant
items.meta_description: Key Responsibilities Qualifications
items.content_html:
MBSI Insight

General Staff Accountant

Key Responsibilities Qualifications

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain and update general ledger accounts by verifying and posting financial transactions.
  • Reconcile bank statements, credit card accounts, and balance sheet accounts monthly.
  • Prepare and process journal entries for month-end and year-end closing processes.
  • Assist in the preparation of internal and external financial statements.
  • Prepare documentation and schedules to support internal and external audits.
  • Ensure financial compliance with local GAAP/IFRS and organizational policies. [1, 2]

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) preferred.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in accounting or finance.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables) and mainstream ERP accounting systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, QuickBooks).

items.h1: Built on accounting discipline, client trust, and continuous improvement.
items.meta_description: Learn about Millennium Business Services, Inc., a Makati-based finance and accounting outsourcing partner with 30 years of accounting, payroll, taxation, and business support experience.
items.content_html:
About MBSI

Built on accounting discipline, client trust, and continuous improvement.

Millennium Business Services, Inc. is an organization of finance and accounting professionals dedicated to high-quality, cost-effective outsourcing services for companies in the Philippines.

Our Story

A finance and accounting outsourcing partner serving businesses since 1996.

Starting with five employees in 1996, MBSI has grown to more than a hundred professional and support staff. For 30 years, the firm has built a reputation for earning the confidence and continued patronage of its clients.

A people-focused organization, MBSI has always affirmed that the integrity, professionalism and quality of its employees are its greatest asset. This is ingrained by the continuous training and development opportunities MBSI provides for its employees and its commitment towards continual improvement.

The MBSI staff are well-trained in accounting, taxation and IT related accounting software; through regular updates on the latest developments in accounting changes in tax laws and regulations and accounting software. Our executives are hands-on managers and supervisors in handling engagements with clients.

Our Purpose

What guides MBSI.

Vision

To be the most admired business process outsourcing company in the Philippines, recognized for delivering high-quality, cost-effective finance and accounting services.

We envision a team of motivated, competent, and dedicated professionals using relevant technology and efficient, safe workplaces to meet client needs, uphold our social and legal responsibilities, and create lasting value for our stakeholders.

Mission

MBSI provides high-quality, cost-effective Finance and Accounting Outsourcing services that help clients operate with accuracy, efficiency, and confidence. Our capabilities include accounting and bookkeeping, financial and management reporting, account analysis and reconciliation, payroll, tax compliance, treasury, receivables and payables administration, and budget monitoring and analysis.

We strengthen our services through continuous training, mentoring, shared learning, and up-to-date technology. We are committed to fair employee compensation, safe and efficient workplaces, career development, responsible growth, sustainable returns for shareholders, and fulfilling our responsibilities to our employees, community, and country.

Share your current setup and our team will help identify the practical support areas where MBSI can assist.

Proper maintenance of all records, preparation, and analysis of the balance sheet and other financial statements are essential in managing a business. Many companies suffer from financial mismanagement because financial information is incomplete, incorrect, or not available on time.

MBSI uses financial data to assess performance, provide recommendations, and support better management decisions through ratio analysis, liquidity review, debt management, profitability analysis, and predictive financial analysis.

MBSI offers Xero cloud accounting support backed by accounting process experience and Xero-certified advisor credentials.

Cloud Accounting Support

Xero support backed by accounting service experience.

Xero Services is MBSI's cloud-based offering for companies looking for an accounting system that is easy to use, simple, economically viable, and capable of covering most accounting requirements.

Our goal is to support responsiveness and service delivery while helping clients realize the ease and benefits of Xero for what Xero calls beautiful business.

The Xero team is composed of accountants, information security managers, IT personnel, and accounting systems implementers with knowledge and experience in cloud accounting workflows.

xero Certified Partner & Advisor

MBSI is a certified partner and advisor of Xero, supporting clients with setup, training, administration, maintenance, and accounting workflows.

Our Xero Service Offerings

Implementation, training, administration, and workflow support

System Implementation

Practical support in setting up Xero so the accounting system reflects operating requirements, chart of accounts, users, and reporting needs.

End-User Training

Training support to help owners, finance staff, and users work confidently inside Xero.

Administration and Maintenance

Ongoing assistance for subscription support, user maintenance, workflow review, and coordination with accounting and bookkeeping work.

Software Subscription

Assistance with selecting and maintaining the appropriate Xero subscription plan based on your accounting, reporting, and user requirements.

Customization and Add-ons

Support for Xero configuration and third-party add-on applications that can improve accounting workflows, reporting, and business administration.

Why Xero?

Cloud accounting designed for efficiency, visibility, and collaboration

Run your business from anywhere

Access business finances from an internet-connected device, including phone, tablet, or computer.

Understand cash position in real time

Use bank-feed updates, dashboards, and reports to understand cash position more clearly.

Collaborate with your team

Invite staff, accountants, bookkeepers, and advisors to work in real time.

Get paid faster

Create invoices, monitor bills, and use reminders or payment options to support cash flow.

Protect business data

Use cloud-based data protection features, backups, encryption, secure access, and authentication controls.

Get help when needed

Access support resources, training, and MBSI guidance for Xero-related accounting workflows.

Explore other services

Bookkeeping, account reconciliation, schedules, records, and recurring management reports.

Learn More

Payroll Management

Accurate payroll processing, statutory deductions, final pay, and employee payroll records.

Learn More

Financial reports and analysis that help management review results and make timely decisions.
